entry.title: Fab it yourself: ordering OpenMicroKbd from JLCPCB
entry.summary: A step-by-step walkthrough, with video, of turning the three files in hw/v1/fab/ into assembled boards: Gerber upload, the stackup and surface finish that matter, two-sided assembly, BOM and CPL matching, and the DFM flags that are documented and safe to ignore.

entry.title: OpenMicroKbd: an open-source build of OpenAI's $230 Codex Micro macropad
entry.summary: An MIT-licensed, wired USB-C macropad that recreates the Codex Micro's control surface for about $37 in parts — an open schematic written in open-source CoHDL, Rust + Embassy firmware, a GPUI companion app, and a fab-ready manufacturing package.
